The product simplifies to  

\[
P = 2^{(\log_3 2)\left(\sum_{k=2}^{28}F_k\right)^2},
\]

so  

\[
\log_2 P = (\log_3 2)\left(\sum_{k=2}^{28}F_k\right)^2,
\qquad
\sqrt{\log_2 P}= \left(\sum_{k=2}^{28}F_k\right)\sqrt{\log_3 2}.
\]

Using the Fibonacci sum identity \(\sum_{k=1}^{n}F_k = F_{n+2}-1\),

\[
\sum_{k=2}^{28}F_k = F_{30} - 2 = 832040 - 2 = 832038.
\]

Hence  

\[
\sqrt{\log_2 P}=832038\,\sqrt{\log_3 2}.
\]

ANSWER: 832038·√(log₃ 2)
